title: Text to Speech in ElevenLabs: Settings That Make AI Voices Sound Human
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: Text to Speech in ElevenLabs: Settings That Make AI Voices Sound Human.

Why does one AI voice sound human and another robotic? This episode walks through the Text to Speech playground, the documented order of importance (voice, then model, then settings), every voice setting and the common starting values, audio tags, pauses per model, text normalization, pronunciation control and free regenerations.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
